exposure: Oligohydramnios diagnosed after 34 weeks of gestation
cohort: 50 pregnant women diagnosed clinically with oligohydramnios and confirmed by ultrasound after 34 weeks of gestation, predominantly primigravidae (72%) and presenting at term (66%).
finding: The study found an incidence of oligohydramnios at 6.63%, with a 72% caesarean section rate, 0% maternal mortality, and a 10% perinatal mortality rate among affected pregnancies.
mod_finding: The caesarean section rate in the cohort was 72%, with 18% experiencing spontaneous labour and 10% induced labour.
gest_age: Diagnosed after 34 weeks of gestation, with 66% of cases presenting at term.
